# apple_app_asset_library (Data Source)

Reads an app's App Asset Library: its ID and its images and videos.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_app_asset_library" "example" {
  app_id = data.apple_app.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the asset library.
- `images` (Attributes List) The library's images. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))
- `videos` (Attributes List) The library's videos. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--videos))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Category of the asset.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the asset.
- `reference_name` (String) Name of the asset in the library.
- `state` (String) State of the asset.


<a id="nestedatt--videos"></a>
### Nested Schema for `videos`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Category of the asset.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the asset.
- `reference_name` (String) Name of the asset in the library.
- `state` (String) State of the asset.
